development_decision: V2 passed at both endpoints with positive paired dynamic-over-static lower bounds and a positive dynamic scale-interaction lower bound. No registered confirmation seed was accessed during V1/V2 tuning.
codebook_template: A retrieved memory states that the hidden value label is{candidate}
text_replay_template: A retrieved memory states that the hidden value label is{candidate}. {query}
query_template: Episode query. Key {key}. The hidden value label is
static_adapter_definition: Freeze the foundation and optimize one episode-invariant replay block on calibration episodes only, selecting the minimum full-calibration-NLL checkpoint. The block receives no episodic signal or test target. Its inference replay token count, width, injection layer, frozen suffix, candidate projection, and mixture-gate protocol exactly match dynamic ASCENT.
same_flop_boundary: Inference-FLOP equality covers replay_from_hidden plus the candidate projection. Offline static training, dynamic memory decoding, parameter/state bytes, and transient memory are separately reported.
confirmation_gates: Every seed-endpoint paired 95% lower bound for dynamic rich ASCENT over the static adapter is positive
At each endpoint, the seed-clustered t(2) 95% lower bound for dynamic rich ASCENT over the static adapter is positive
The seed-clustered t(2) 95% lower bound for the large-minus-small dynamic rich gain is positive
Every seed has exact replay-token-count, injection-layer, frozen-suffix, config, model-hash, label, signal, query-input, clean-commit, and test-label gates
interpretation: Confirmatory same-inference-FLOP static-adapter control for ASCENT latent replay. FPVM excluded.
